request.user:
Subject: Zoology
Question type: single-correct (exactly one option is right)

Consumption of which one of the following foods can prevent the kind of blindness associated with vitamin 'A' deficiency?
(A) 'Flavr Savr' tomato
(B) Canolla
(C) Golden rice
(D) Bt-Brinjal

result.working: Vitamin A deficiency causes night blindness and xerophthalmia. Golden rice is genetically modified to produce beta-carotene, a provitamin A, in the grain, so eating it can prevent this blindness. Flavr Savr tomato has a longer shelf life, canola is an oilseed crop with modified fatty acid content, and Bt-brinjal resists insect pests.
